item.title: Important notice for Iranian Ceno users
item.description:
We deliver a daily package of independent international media to Iran via TV satellite. During shutdown, Ceno users can open the websites below using Public Mode.
Note: requests made in Public Mode are public on the BitTorrent network.
If you have any access in Iran, download, use, and share Ceno.
